categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Huiyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of anti-tumor innovative drugs and high-quality generic drugs, especially injectable formulations. The company also extends its business to CDMO services, providing drug development, raw material and formulation production, and international registration and sales. Additionally, it develops medical devices mainly in injection forms for consumer healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including dual-target small molecule drug design, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), and three-antibody immunotherapy platforms. It has established robust platforms for injectable generic drugs with comprehensive consistency evaluation systems, complex formulation production, and quality control technologies. Manufacturing adheres to stringent GMP standards from China, EU, and US, with continuous improvements in production processes, cost control, and quality management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, especially tiered hospitals in China, served mainly through volume-based procurement and academic promotion channels. Internationally, the company targets public hospitals and healthcare systems in Europe, the US, and emerging markets across Asia, Oceania, North America, and Africa. Major domestic distributors include state-owned pharmaceutical companies such as Sinopharm and China Resources Pharmaceutical.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production bases in Sichuan Province. It has expanded its international footprint with subsidiaries and sales operations in Europe (UK, Germany, Italy, France, Spain, Portugal, Netherlands, Nordic and Eastern Europe), the United States, and emerging markets including Algeria, Canada, Philippines, and Pakistan, covering over 70 countries globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huiyu Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug research and development, raw material production, formulation manufacturing, and distribution. It also provides CDMO services, supporting other pharmaceutical companies in drug development and manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, accelerating the development of first-in-class and improved new drugs, particularly in oncology. It emphasizes dual-target small molecule drugs, biologics including ADCs, and complex injectable generics. R&D efforts prioritize clinical value, differentiation, and high technical barriers. The company also invests in AI technologies to enhance R&D, production, supply chain, and customer service efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals, including innovative and generic drugs. Additional revenue streams include technical service fees from CDMO activities and international product licensing. The company participates in government-led volume-based procurement and hospital tenders domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huiyu Pharmaceutical is positioned as a leading domestic player in the oncology injectable drug market and a growing international pharmaceutical company. It competes with major multinational pharmaceutical firms and leading Chinese companies such as Jiangsu Hengrui and Qilu Pharmaceutical. The company holds top market shares in several oncology injectable products in China and is recognized among the top 100 Chinese chemical drug enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, an 18.05% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 325 million, up 132.78%. Total assets reached RMB 5.17 billion, growing 10.24%. R&D investment accounted for 31.64% of revenue. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and has steadily increased profitability and equity base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huiyu Pharmaceutical emphasizes providing effective, high-quality, and affordable oncology drugs to patients globally, aiming to make cancer a manageable chronic disease. Its competitive differentiation lies in its innovation-driven pipeline, advanced dual-target and biologic drug platforms, comprehensive quality management systems compliant with international standards, and integrated raw material and formulation production capabilities. The company also leverages its international registration expertise and extensive global sales network to enhance market access.
